old: Cromer served on the 1878 commission that took control of Egyptian finances and later ruled Egypt as British Consul-General, so blaming Ismail's recklessness helped justify European control.
new: Cromer served on the 1878 commission of inquiry into Egyptian finances and later ruled Egypt as British Consul-General, so blaming Ismail's recklessness helped justify European control.
why: The 1878 body was a commission of inquiry, not one that took control of finances (Isma'il Pasha article: 'A further commission of inquiry by Major Evelyn Baring ... in 1878'); control came via the Caisse and Dual Control.

old: Britain led the United States in building public power stations that year
new: Britain had built far more public power stations than the United States by the end of 1882
why: 'Britain led the US' is defensible as written: Holborn Viaduct opened 12 January 1882, before Pearl Street (September 1882), so a second option was also arguably correct; reworded to be clearly false.
